description: Wraps POST /api/incidents/{id}/recheck. Check an incident again now. The monitor checks it again within 30 seconds, after a fix, instead of waiting for the next scheduled check. Not every kind can be checked again (409). It acts for the whole team. Needs a Member or Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
name: incidents_by_id_recheck

kind.description: what kind of problem, as in /api/incidents

recheckRequested.description: a check again is queued (the monitor makes it within 30 seconds)

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: Check an incident again now
